title: Decide whether loyalty left-or-right choice is an existing capability

evidence.paragraph: Choose left or right. Each player gains control of all nonland permanents other than Aminatou controlled by the next player in the chosen direction.
Choose left or right. Until your next turn, each player may attack only the nearest opponent in the last chosen direction and planeswalkers controlled by that opponent.

required_behavior: Return PARK/NEEDS_PRIMITIVE unless the packet itself proves an existing engine representation for directional player-order choice and both downstream effects.
Do not propose source edits or claim that generic target selection covers this mechanic.
gates: response is one structured verdict and contains no edit block
on_failure: Record raw response and telemetry; do not retry with a larger model because this ticket is a capability decision, not implementation work.
